description: Use this when the user wants to save their export configuration as a reusable template.

email.description: Default recipient for exports from this template that are sent by email

exportedFields.description: Columns, in order, as field IDs from export_fields, with the field scope that export_report_types names for the report type. Leave it out for the report's default columns. Only for report types that take columns.

filename.description: File name of the template's exports, up to 50 characters, without extension. Leave it out for "timesheet".

filter.description: Billing status: all, billable, notBillable, paid, unpaid (billable, not paid), billed or outstanding (billed, not paid). Leave it out for all.

format.description: File format: xlsx (Excel), xlsx1904 (Excel with the 1904 date system), csv or pdf. Leave it out for xlsx.

projectIds.description: Only entries of these projects (IDs from project_list). Leave it out for all projects.

report.description: Report type identifier. Use export_report_types to get available types.

splitTask.description: Split each entry at its breaks: one row per stretch of work, without the break columns. Off when left out.

summarize.description: Add a totals row at the end; the entries are still listed. Off when left out.

tagIds.description: Only entries with these tags (IDs from tag_list). Leave it out for all entries.

teamIds.description: Only entries of these teams (IDs from team_list). Leave it out for all teams.

title.description: Heading printed at the top of the template's PDF exports, such as "Hours report, Jane Smith", up to 255 characters. Leave it out for the report's name. Only used when format is pdf: Excel and CSV exports have no title row.

type.description: Entry type: all, task (time entries), mileage or call. Leave it out for all.

userIds.description: Only entries of these members (user IDs). Leave it out for all members.

name: export_template_create
title: Create Export Template
